data_source: archived Tencent-adjusted fullmarket ETF daily parquet

definitions.index_family: each known underlying tracked index counts once; group daily median ETF percentage return
definitions.composite: equal mean of 3 index-family daily return proxies, each 1/3
definitions.benchmark: ETF price proxies, not official index level or underlying constituent returns
definitions.relative_excess: window cashflow ETF return minus window selected broad-market ETF return in percentage points
definitions.risk: adjusted price rounding and fund inception/survivorship, missing observations, no flows/official index NAV

episode_contract.signal: 26-day weighted OLS annual crosses positive, first R2 improvement qualified within 1-3 sessions
episode_contract.entry: qualify T close -> T+1 representative ETF open
episode_contract.exit: first annual<=0 at close -> next day representative ETF open; no 20-session limit
episode_contract.reentry: new annual nonpositive-to-positive crossing and subsequent qualification after exit
episode_contract.cash: 0 return while out of market, no opportunity-cost benchmark
episode_contract.price_signal_warning: median group ETF return reconstructed into synthetic NAV-100 signal; actual underlying index not available
episode_contract.right_censored: current open positions marked at 2026-10-20 close, gross return and one-sided cost only
